pattern: refresh a provider's stale model list
experience: After the user upgraded their plan, Ada kept the provider's old model list. The agent had no refresh tool, so it toggled the provider off and on in settings.json.
rule: t3_provider_refresh: Recheck this server's providers and re-discover their models.

source.note: A plan upgrade left Antigravity's old models in place until the provider was switched off and on in settings.json.

prompt: I just upgraded my Google plan but Antigravity in Ada still only shows the old models. Can you get the new ones to show up?

pattern: ordinary task: edit the project's own model list
experience: The user's project keeps its own list of models. Adding one is a file edit, not a provider refresh.
rule: t3_provider_refresh: Recheck this server's providers and re-discover their models.

source.note: Guards the provider refresh tool against requests about a project's own model config.

prompt: Add gemini-3.1-ultra to the model list in src/models.ts.
